description: Header file defining the BoxedKernel class and related functions for kernel dispatching in PyTorch's ATen library, including fallthrough, ambiguity, and error-reporting kernels.

classes.name: BoxedKernel
classes.description: A class representing a boxed kernel, similar to std::function, used for dispatching kernels with support for fallthrough, ambiguity, and error reporting.

methods.name: callBoxed
methods.description: Invokes the boxed kernel with the provided operator handle, dispatch key set, and stack.

methods.name: makeFromFunction
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel from a static boxed function pointer.

methods.name: makeFromFunctor
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel from a functor object.

methods.name: makeFallthrough
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel that implements fallthrough behavior.

methods.name: makeAmbiguousAutogradOther
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel that reports ambiguity in AutogradOther kernel.

methods.name: makeNamedNotSupported
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel that reports named tensor not supported error.
